props.text: Lymphatic drainage massage is a slow, very light massage that follows the body's lymph pathways. Here in Seminyak we give it as a fusion of manual lymphatic drainage (MLD) and wood therapy, in sessions of 1, 1.5 or 2 hours from IDR 300.000, at our spa or at your villa or hotel. It's often chosen after a long flight, when legs or ankles feel heavy or puffy.

props.title: Manual Lymphatic Drainage and Wood Therapy

children: Each session is a fusion: mostly manual lymphatic drainage (MLD), slow, very light, rhythmic strokes by hand that move the skin toward the lymph nodes, mixed with wood therapy, which many guests enjoy. Our therapists are certified massage therapists, trained in MLD by experienced trainers. The hand strokes stay light because lymph vessels sit just under the skin. For background on the lymphatic system and what the massage can and can't do, see our

props.label: What is MLD?
props.title: Manual lymphatic drainage (MLD)
props.definition: A very light, slow massage that stretches the skin in the direction lymph flows, towards the lymph nodes. It was developed in the 1930s by Emil and Estrid Vodder, and clinics also use it for lymphoedema.
props.more: As a spa treatment it is relaxing rather than medical: many people find puffy legs and ankles feel lighter for a while afterwards.

props.label: What is wood therapy?
props.title: Wood therapy
props.definition: Massage with smooth wooden tools, such as rollers, a cup and a curved paddle, as well as the hands. In Spanish it is called maderoterapia, and it is popular in Latin America and in spas around the world.
props.more: In our lymphatic massage the therapist mostly uses the rollers, at a light, quick pace. The tools cost nothing extra and come to your villa too.

props.title: How a Lymphatic Massage Session Runs
props.text: A session starts with a short chat about how you feel, any health conditions and the areas you'd like focused on; then your therapist works from the neck and collarbone down to the ankles, always stroking toward the nearest lymph nodes and mixing in the wooden rollers. A longer session adds time, not pressure. You stay covered with a towel or spa wear, and only the area being massaged is uncovered.

featuresRight: Upper legs, then calves and ankles

props.subTitle: Frequently Asked Questions
props.title: Questions About Lymphatic Drainage Massage

items.question: How do I book a lymphatic massage?
items.answer: Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, between 9am and 11pm, with the day, the time, the session length and whether you'd like it at the spa or at your villa or hotel. We reply to confirm your time.

items.question: Can I book a lymphatic massage for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability: message us with the time you'd like and we'll confirm the next free slot. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can two of us book at the same time?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us how many guests and which treatments when you book, and we'll confirm a time when enough therapists are free, at the spa or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at the spa or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: Can I have a lymphatic massage after liposuction or other surgery?
items.answer: Only once your surgeon has cleared you for it. Tell us the procedure and its date when you book, and we will check with you that the session is right for you.

items.question: Can I combine it with other treatments?
items.answer: Yes. The Lymphatic & Gold Facial pairs 1 hour of each for IDR 525.000 per person (IDR 569.000 booked separately), and many guests add foot reflexology or a body scrub to the same visit.

items.question: Does wood therapy cost extra?
items.answer: No. It is part of the lymphatic massage price, and your therapist brings the wooden tools to your villa or hotel too.

items.question: Can I have lymphatic drainage on my face?
items.answer: Yes, as part of the 1-hour [Bali Moon Facial](/seminyak/facial/), which includes an argan oil lymphatic facial massage. The lymphatic massage on this page works on the body, from the neck down.

items.question: What should I do after a lymphatic massage?
items.answer: Drink water and rest. Some people feel tired, thirsty or slightly light-headed afterwards.

items.question: What if I need to cancel or change my booking?
items.answer: You can cancel or reschedule up to 12 hours before your appointment at no charge. Within 12 hours a 50% fee applies, and a no-show is charged the full treatment price or the deposit ([terms and conditions](/terms-and-conditions/)).
